svg.text: RMSNorm and RoPE on the vector unit: ~5.0 ms, ~200 tokens/s
+ a hardware job list per layer: ~4.0-4.3 ms, ~230-250 tokens/s
One token: 6.1 ms (165 tokens/s), stories15M, 168-token story, measured on the board by the firmware's cycle counter
if nothing but the weight streaming were left: ~370-420 tokens/s,
the ceiling for this board with bit-exact int8 weights
- weights: 17.1 MB (15.2 M int8 + one float32 scale per 32), every token; the matmuls run at 5.5 GB/s effective, 77 % of the DDR3 peak
- KV cache reads: ~1.7 MB on average over the story (3.5 MB at position 255); writes: 13.8 KB
- about 300 hardware jobs (43 matmuls, 144 attention / softmax / copy, 72 KV DMA, 31 quantize / SwiGLU), each started and polled by the CPU over AXI4-Lite
Every step waits for the one before it (the forward pass is a dependency chain), so the parts add up. Even with the CPU's work and all control at zero, the weights alone take ~2.5 ms.
